name: Choukui no Hana
source:
A police detective is sent to investigate several mysterious deaths involving men who die while having sex. He encounters an extremely beautiful police chief who is specially assigned to investigate the serial murders. As they dig deeper into the case, the detective discovers the existence of two special "type" of humans who have special / hidden physical stats and abilities, namely the "Flower" clan and the "Butterfly" clan. What has it got to do with the deaths?

[Edited from Aarinfantasy Forums]
translation:
一名刑警受命调查数起神秘死亡案件，死者都是在性交过程中毙命的男性。他遇见了一位极其美丽的警察局长，对方被特别指派调查这一连串谋杀。随着调查深入，刑警发现世上存在两种特殊“类型”的人类，拥有隐藏的身体素质与能力，分别是“花”之一族和“蝶”之一族。这与那些死亡案件究竟有何关系？
